api: documentRelation(candidate, cache?) -> RelationEvidence | undefined; DocumentRelationCache = WeakMap<Element, unknown>

evidence.relatedLabel: academic actual fixed row title only
evidence.dependencyReferences: evidenceNodes actual elements, used parents, fixed heading/caption/column/row-title/control descendants including equal-content node replacement
evidence.cache: No stored DOM result; optional batch cache currently unused, relationships recomputed even when same WeakMap is passed. No persistent cache.

coverage.syntheticVariants: Unfamiliar fixed names and arbitrary IDs/query values; columns reordered; floor rowspan in multiple column orders; article/form/editable/hidden/ARIA-interactive boundaries; nested private getter traps; ambiguous/missing/merged/nested headers/rows; selected peer ambiguity and operation peers; same-content node replacements; name/table/heading visit bounds; independent identities for duplicate generic PDF labels.
coverage.originalRelationMeaning: Direct module evidence checks using actual analyzer raw candidates on already-exposed fixture DOM. Not classifier/ranker/UI quality results and not new independent evidence.
coverage.oldTraceMeaning: RUN008 post-first trace establishes raw-but-unclassified misses before this work; it is not rerun or replaced.

preservedIntermediateFailures.cause: Synthetic intercepted HTML lacked UTF-8 charset, causing mojibake and missing semantic proof; original fixtures had own charset. Negative passes were not used as sufficient proof. Harness corrected. All original files/first failures preserved.
Test incorrectly expected locate candidate.target=_blank; existing sourceAction locate target is undefined. Source DOM target is preserved as _blank and checked separately. No sourceAction change.
Pre-final passing run before replacing broad descendant queries with explicit visit bounds.
TypeScript TS5112 requires --ignoreConfig with explicit input files. Command corrected; no source type error reported.

integrationRequired: Root classifier applies common danger URL/script/label checks before new relation evidence; no safety-rejected revival.
Root owns classification/currentness/ranking/UI copying and full regression/quality/performance validation.
Root currentness must compare relation fingerprint and actual dependency element identities; module tests compare its own recomputation directly, not unintegrated product currentness.
limits: No classifier/ranker/UI score or fresh evaluation claims. Existing 60 exposed pages remain development material.
No native installation, VoiceOver, actual zoom, user-study or real workflow completion performed.
Only explicit aligned HTML tables with one header row and one tbody; only noninteractive fixed table metadata.
Academic support vocabulary and selected local document layout are deliberately bounded; no broad financial document or arbitrary PDF inference.
No standalone danger bypass or action execution API is provided; callers must retain common safety and snapshot policies.
No overall performance claim or new benchmark run.
Parent must bind final freeze hash after any later integration changes.
